newsitem.title: ESTONIA: NEW LISTINGS PROVOKE NO INTEREST ON SLOW BOURSE.
newsitem.headline: NEW LISTINGS PROVOKE NO INTEREST ON SLOW BOURSE.

text.p: The Estonian bourse remained
flat on Tuesday morning with little interest provoked by the
new listing of Klementi and Eesti Naitused's move the main
list, dealers said.
Trade volume on the main list at 08300 GMT was 14.1
million kroons with the Talse online index 0.25 percent lower
"Klementi was listed today, but there is little interest in
the market in general so nothing happened this morning," one
dealer said.
"The market is expected to stay slow for the day," the
dealer added.
Hoiupank was the most active stock on registered trade of
4.4 million kroons for a spread of 131.25/131.90 kroons
compared to Monday's close of 130.60 kroons
Hansapank saw morning trade of 3.7 million kroons to ease
with a spread of 130.00/130.95 kroons vs 132.00 kroons.
The free market turned over 2.1 million kroons with
diversified industrialist Norma the most active with
1.3 million kroons traded.
-- David Mardiste, Tallinn Newsroom, +372 630 8400,
reuters@reuters.ee
